Sensitivity of the model to its parameters around the fitted optima

run_sensitivity.Rd

For each optimal fit (one row of opt_pars per loss function), draws n_sims parameter sets from normal distributions around the fitted values (log scale for v1 and sigma, truncated to the bounds lo and hi) and simulates each.

Usage

run_sensitivity(
  opt_pars,
  samodel,
  tswitch,
  nyears,
  sd_pars,
  use_switch = TRUE,
  n_sims = 100,
  n_cores = 1
)

Arguments

opt_pars

Optimal fits, one row per loss, with a loss column and PAR_NAMES.

samodel, tswitch, nyears, use_switch

As in run_model().

sd_pars

Data frame with columns par (logv1, logsigma, portion), SD, lo and hi (bounds on the sampling scale).

n_sims

Number of parameter draws per loss function.

n_cores

Cores for the simulations (> 1 uses mclapply, Linux/macOS only).

Value

A list with opt_traj (trajectories of the optimal fits), par_df (the draws, sampling scale), opt_settings (the optimal values, sampling scale), sim_out (trajectories of all draws) and failed (draws whose simulation failed).
